units.source_text: 此后源氏公子偶尔遇见王命妇时，总是竭尽言词，要她设法引导会面，然而毫无成效。

en.t: After that, whenever Prince Genji happened to meet Omyobu, he exhausted every possible argument, begging her to arrange a meeting, but it was all to no avail.

units.source_text: 公子思念婴儿，时刻不忘，对王命妇说定要一见。

en.t: The prince longed for the baby and could not forget him for a moment, telling Omyobu that he absolutely had to see him.

units.source_text: 王命妇答道：“您怎么说这没道理的话！将来自会看见的呀！”

en.t: Omyobu replied, "How can you say such unreasonable things? In time, you will naturally be able to see him."

units.source_text: 她嘴上虽然严词拒绝，脸上表示无限同情与烦恼。

en.t: Although her words were stern as she refused him, her face showed boundless sympathy and distress.

units.source_text: 源氏公子正像哑子吃黄连，说不出的苦。

en.t: Prince Genji was like a mute person tasting bitter coptis, suffering a bitterness he could not put into words.

units.source_text: 只能暗自思忖：“不知哪生哪世，能不假传达，与妃子直接晤谈？”

en.t: He could only think to himself, "In what lifetime, in what world, will I be able to speak directly with the lady without relying on an intermediary?"

units.source_text: 那悲叹哭泣之相，教旁人看了也很难过。

en.t: The sight of him lamenting and weeping so bitterly was painful even for others to see.
